status: PROPOSAL, UNWIRED. R4's generation-2 gating reference written as a spec; it adopts nothing, and any use is PROPOSED-REQUIRES-OWNER-APPROVAL.
formula: p_timeout = (n0 * pi0 + T) / (n0 + K); p_up = p_down = (1 - p_timeout) / 2, computed once; K == 0 returns pi0 exactly
label_rule: r = close[j + horizon_bars] / close[j] - 1; UP if r > band, DOWN if r < -band, else TIMEOUT
population: anchors whose reference_close (UTC epoch seconds) is a multiple of lattice_bars * bar_seconds
day_type_rule: the UTC calendar date of reference_close: 0 weekday (Monday-Friday), 1 Saturday, 2 Sunday
counting_rule: K and T count anchors of the same day type with horizon_end <= reference_close and horizon_end > reference_close - memory_days, and reference_close >= the deployment start when one is given; T counts their TIMEOUT labels
prior: pi0 per day type, supplied by the caller from a frozen corpus; never computed here

provenance.where: local research files, not in this repository: research3/wave2/gate/reference.py, research3/r4/v1/REFERENCE_SPEC_V2.json, research3/wave2/gate/REFERENCE_SPEC.json
